provider_organization: Hungarian Government, run by the Tempus Public Foundation
degree_fields: Other fields set by the Nigerian partner (doctoral: any field)
eligible_nationalities: Citizens of other Stipendium Hungaricum partner countries (list on stipendiumhungaricum.hu)

stipend.notes: Bachelor's and master's: HUF 43,700 a month, 12 months a year. Doctoral: HUF 140,000 a month in the first 4 semesters, HUF 180,000 in the next 4. Described as a contribution to living costs only.

additional_benefits: Free dormitory place or HUF 40,000 a month towards housing
Hungarian state health care plus supplementary insurance up to HUF 65,000 a year
Free compulsory Hungarian language course (two semesters)

application_fee.notes: The official site says online registration and entrance exams are free and warns against paying agencies.

language_proficiency: Hungarian B2 for Hungarian-taught programmes (a one-year preparatory course is available)
Other programmes: each university's language requirement

country_specific_notes.note: Nigeria is a partner country. The sending partner is the Federal Ministry of Education, Department of Scholarship Awards (Abuja), which nominates applicants. Bachelor's, master's and one-tier master's are offered in listed fields; doctoral study in any field.

required_documents.name: Passport or national ID
required_documents.detail: A national ID copy plus signed declaration can replace the passport at application; a valid passport is needed by 1 August (2026/27 call)

required_documents.name: Supervisor's statement
required_documents.detail: Doctoral applicants only, if the doctoral school asks for it (by 15 Mar in the 2026/27 call)

preparation_alerts: Apply in the online system and also to the Nigerian sending partner, which nominates by end of February
Nominated applicants take university entrance exams between mid-March and late May

criteria.notes: Best applicants nominated by end of February

verification_status.verification_notes: The 2027/28 call is not published yet, so status and dates are unknown. Rules and amounts here come from the 2026/27 call (deadline 15 Jan 2026, 14:00 CET) and may change. The partner list gives a yahoo.com contact for the Nigerian partner; applications go through the official online system, but a human should confirm the ministry's current contact. A 2019 tweet mentioned a USD 150 fee; the official site says applying is free. Leads.csv had this programme twice.
